title: A parallel dual-stream state-space module for reliable and efficient biomedical relation extraction.

title: Topical Glycolysis Inhibition Restores MAVS-Associated Antiviral Signaling in Herpes Simplex Keratitis.
snippet: Herpes simplex keratitis (HSK) is a leading cause of infectious corneal blindness. title: Computer-assisted and image-guided surgery for surgical lymph-nodal staging of gynecologic cancer in the era of digital and robotic surgery: a review of current evidence.
snippet: Accurate lymph node staging is central to prognostic stratification and therapeutic decision-making in gynecologic oncology.
